name: Tobias
title: Grand Master

villagemaster/30297.htm.text: Grand Master Tobias: Welcome, young brethren -- may the power of Shilen grant you peace. When someone comes to a place like this, to see a person like me, there is always some pressing reason. What do you wish to ask me? I will gladly assist you in any way I can.

links.text: Listen to information about first class transfer.

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/30297-01.html.text: Master Tobias: (Hand over the document.) Ah, you are the messenger sent by Gobie! Thank you for coming so far, so fast. I will make good use of the information you have provided us.

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/30297-02.html.text: Master Tobias: I sense a strong aura of power emanating from you...

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/30297-05.html.text: Master Tobias: Ah... The document is ready. Please deliver this to Gobie .

Q00143_FallenAngelRequestOfDusk/30297-01.text: Grand Master Tobias: Sealed Prophecy? Fallen angels? I don't know what you are talking about... I think you have the wrong person...

Q00143_FallenAngelRequestOfDusk/30297-04.text: Grand Master Tobias: (Tobias seems to conduct some kind of a ritual while holding the Sealed Prophecy. A bright light briefly shines forth from the Writings, then fades...) There! It is unsealed... If you can interpret this properly, you should be able to determine the location of the fallen angel.…

Q00143_FallenAngelRequestOfDusk/30297-02.text: Grand Master Tobias: Sealed Prophecy? Fallen angels? I don't know what you are talking about...

links.text: Give him the Sealed Prophecy - Path of the God.

Q00143_FallenAngelRequestOfDusk/30297-06.text: Grand Master Tobias: Elder Casian is somewhere in the wilderness -- his medicine can heal the angel. Find him and obtain the medicine. After he tells you the angel's exact location, heal the angel, place her message within this empty Echo Crystal and bring it to me... Casian will give you the detai…

Q00143_FallenAngelRequestOfDusk/30297-07.text: Grand Master Tobias: Ah, I had every confidence that you would succeed! Well done! However, we still cannot officially denounce the hypocrisy of the Temple or the Rulers of Dawn. The nobility will never see the proof we lay before them...not yet, at any rate. But your service to our cause will not …

Q00464_Oath/30297-01.html.text: Grand Master Tobias: What brought you here?

links.text: Say you're here to give him this book.

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/30297-03.html.text: Master Tobias: I sense a strong aura of power emanating from you...

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/30297-04.html.text: Master Tobias: We respect mighty warriors and skilled fighters, not those hypocrites with their smooth and oily tongues... So we respect your race with its courage and strength in battle. And you yourself are obviously a great and renowned Kamael.

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/30297-06.html.text: Master Tobias: Ah... The document is ready. Please deliver this to Gobie .

Q00143_FallenAngelRequestOfDusk/30297-03.text: Grand Master Tobias: What's this? The Sealed Prophecy - Path of the God? Surely you must have been sent by Shadow Fox! To discover the location of the angel, we must open the seal. Wait a moment while I do so... Once this document is unsealed, I must ask a favor of you.

Q00143_FallenAngelRequestOfDusk/30297-05.text: Grand Master Tobias: Both the Preachers of the Wilderness and the Revolutionaries of Dusk heard the sounds of the angel crying for help. She seems to be injured and fleeing something very powerful. Now that we know where she is, we must offer what aid we can. Go find Elder Casian in the Wasteland a…

Q00464_Oath/30297-02.html.text: Grand Master Tobias: Hm... I lost this book a LONG time ago! Thank you, brother! Funny... This is a kid's book, I remember taking it so seriously! Ah, to be young. Anyhow, thank you for this unexpected gift. I thank you again.
